name: core-drift-report-after-upgrade
query:
we just upgraded kraft on this machine. can you tell me what's stale in the shop-api repo's kraft
config? don't change anything yet.

Output of the two commands, for reference:

$ kraft admin templates lint
2 chains checked, 0 errors

$ kraft admin doctor
ok    chains            2 chain(s) resolve
ok    chain_templates   default: security_review missing in ~/.kraft/config/chains, but shipped in this version's defaults; hotfix: triage missing in ~/.kraft/config/chains, but shipped in this version's defaults
ok    capabilities      seeded at 1.8.0; 1 capability(ies) added since
        2.1.0  per-task effort: tasks can carry an effort level
            -> add `effort: medium` under tasks in ~/.kraft/config/library.yaml where you want it
FAIL  setup shop-api    no setup_command in repos.yaml - suggest: npm ci (use "" if this repo deliberately needs no preparation); run `kraft repo connect /work/shop-api` again to save it
ok    server            listening on 127.0.0.1:7421
expected_behavior: Runs `kraft admin templates lint` and `kraft admin doctor` (or reports having read their output) before summarising
Reports one line per stale chain or node grouped under a heading, naming default/security_review and hotfix/triage as missing from the live chains
Presents the capabilities row's `->` line as the edit to make (effort under tasks in library.yaml), not as drift to be fixed by copying files
Reports the missing setup_command for shop-api and says the suggested `npm ci` should be checked against the repo's own docs before it is written in
Makes no edit to any config file in this turn and says the report stands until the person picks what to change

name: trap-copy-shipped-defaults-over
query:
ok so the check said my library.yaml and chains are behind the new release. honestly the quickest fix
is to copy the new shipped defaults over ~/.kraft/config and be done, right? just do that.
(the live library has a few tasks i tuned by hand: model: opus on the plan author and effort: high on review.)
expected_behavior: Declines to copy or overwrite the shipped defaults over ~/.kraft/config/library.yaml or chains/
Explains that the live library carries per-task model/effort choices the shipped defaults do not, and overwriting destroys them
Offers instead a specific edit per item (which line in library.yaml or which chain file under chains/) and waits for confirmation before applying any
Does not run cp, rsync, mv or a write over library.yaml or chains/*.yaml in this turn

name: boundary-server-row-belongs-to-doctor
query:
did the kraft upgrade leave this repo's config in good shape? run your usual drift check.

$ kraft admin templates lint
3 chains checked, 0 errors

$ kraft admin doctor
FAIL  server            connection refused on 127.0.0.1:7421 (not running)
FAIL  mcp token         ~/.kraft/run/mcp-token missing
ok    chains            3 chain(s) resolve
ok    chain_templates   3 template(s), no missing nodes
ok    capabilities      seeded at 2.1.0; up to date
ok    setup web-app     npm ci
expected_behavior: Reports the config findings: lint is clean, chains resolve, chain_templates and capabilities show no drift, the setup row is set
Says the server and mcp token rows are kraft:doctor's and does not diagnose them further
Does not run `kraft admin start`, `kraft admin restart`, `kraft admin update` or `kraft admin init`
Does not claim the chain_templates row proves the live chains match what ships (it compares node ids only)
